name: Simple XML Sitemap Extensions
description: Adds extensions to the Simple XML Sitemap module.
project_description:
Extends your Simple XML Sitemap to add support for sitemap index files and configuring

variants per index file.

 Back to top 

 When do I need Simple Sitemap Extensions? 
 
 SEO is important for your website, and ... 
 When you use Simple XML Sitemap, and ... 
 When you have a large sitemap that you want to break up into multiple sitemaps. Out-of-the-box you can create individual sitemap files that list nodes by the month in which they are created. 
 
 Back to top 

 When do I NOT need Simple Sitemap Extensions? 
 
 When a single sitemap file is enough. 
 
 Back to top 

 How do I use Simple Sitemap Extensions effectively? 
 
 Install and enable as usual. 
 If you wish to create individual sitemap files that list nodes by the month in which they are created, enable the sse_dynamic_monthly sub-module. 
 Permission settings are managed by the Simple XML Sitemap module. You must be a user with the administer sitemap settings and administer nodes permission. 
 Note: The next steps will alter your website configuration. 
 Create sitemap variants:
 
 Go to /admin/config/search/simplesitemap/variants 
 add one or more variants of type sitemap_index `index | sitemap_index | Sitemap Index`
 or multiple:

 `site-a_index | sitemap_index | Sitemap Index Site A`

 `site-b_index | sitemap_index | Sitemap Index Site B`

 `site-c_index | sitemap_index | Sitemap Index Site C`

 
 
 
 
 Go to /admin/config/search/simplesitemap/settings. Set the default sitemap variant to the sitemap index. 
 Go to /admin/config/search/simplesitemap/sitemap-index. Enable the variants which should be on the sitemap index. 
 Save and update your project configuration. New items have been added. 
 Fully regenerate your sitemaps.
